intro: How to use the clan bot.

pages.blurb: Three steps to set up your cards.
short: In three steps:
1. Link your RSN. Press **Link RSN** under the guide post in #bot-guide and type your RSN.
2. Set your account type. Press **Account Type** under the same post. Your own cards will not run until you set it.
3. Sync your collection log. Install RuneProfile in RuneLite, open your Collection Log, and press the RuneProfile button in the top-left. That is what lets the bot read your log for your cards.
Stats and KC need nothing else. The bot looks your name up on Wise Old Man.
pages.title: Getting started

pages.blurb: Stats come from Wise Old Man. Your collection log comes from RuneProfile.
short: Stats and KC come from Wise Old Man. The bot looks your name up. There is nothing to install.
Your collection log comes from RuneProfile. It reads the log pages you open in game.
Personal bests come from the clan plugin.
Personal bests are not live yet.
pages.title: How it works

pages.blurb: Link your RSN so the bot uses it for your cards.
short: Link your RSN: press **Link RSN** under the guide post in #bot-guide and type your RSN. Commands use your name when you leave it blank.
pages.title: Link your RSN

pages.blurb: Iron, main, or group iron. The cards read it.
short: Press **Account Type** under the guide post to set the mode for each of your accounts.
Your own cards won't run until you set it.
Group iron modes can't be detected. Those have to be picked by hand.
pages.title: Set your account type

pages.blurb: Your log comes from RuneProfile. Open its pages in game to sync them.
fullExtra: A boss page syncs only after you open it in game. If one boss will not score, open its page and press the button again.
short: Stats and KC need nothing. The bot looks your name up on Wise Old Man.
Your collection log needs RuneProfile:
1. Open your RuneLite client.
2. Open the Plugin Hub (bottom of the plugin list).
3. Search for RuneProfile.
4. Click Install.
5. Log in on the account. There is no RSN to type in, it reads the account you're on.
6. Open your Collection Log and press the RuneProfile button in the top-left.
pages.title: Sync your collection log

pages.blurb: Only link your own RSN. We never ask for a Jagex login.
short: Only link your own RSN. Linking proves the name is real. It does not prove it is yours.
Website login goes through Discord's own page. Your password is typed on Discord, never on our site. The site gets your Discord ID and username only. It cannot read your messages or post as you.
We never ask for a Jagex login anywhere. Anything that does is a scam.
pages.title: Safety

pages.blurb: Kills and drops for any boss.

images.caption: What `/kc zulrah` posts: the kill count and the collection log items.

short: `/kc zulrah` - Boss kills and its collection log items.
Boss names work alone: `!toa`, `!zulrah`. They post the same card as `/kc`.

pages.blurb: Your whole log: what you have and what you still need.

images.caption: What `/clog` posts: your whole log and every tab.

short: `/clog` - Your whole log, or one page.
pages.title: Collection log cards

pages.blurb: See what you are dry on and your luck.

images.caption: What `/dry zulrah` posts: what you're dry on, and your luck.

short: `/dry zulrah` - What you're dry on, and your luck.
pages.title: Dry and luck

pages.blurb: Levels, totals, and your best times.
fullExtra: Data comes from Wise Old Man and RuneProfile.
`/pb` reads PBs from the clan plugin.

images.caption: What `/gains` posts: XP and KC gained over the last day, week, month, or year.

short: `/skills` - Levels and XP.
`/gains` - XP and KC gained over the last day, week, month, or year.
pages.title: Gains, profile and PBs

pages.blurb: Compare two players on one card.

images.caption: The Overall view: totals side by side.
A boss head to head: kill counts, both collection logs, and the luck on each drop.

short: `/compare RSN1 RSN2`. One name compares them against you.
Anyone can flip the views. Only you can change the players.
pages.title: Compare

pages.blurb: Every card as a typed command.
fullExtra: The text versions came first. The slash versions are listed after you type `/`.
short: Every card command has a text version. Type it in any channel, or in a DM.
`!kc zulrah` · `!clog` · `!skills`
`!dry zulrah` · `!gains` · `!compare`
`!pb` · `!profile` · `!leaderboard`
Shortcuts: `!log` = clog, `!lvl` = skills. Plain names work: `!kc nightmare`.
pages.title: Text commands

pages.blurb: One PvM contract, one Skilling contract.
fullExtra: Want the ping when a new one posts? Take the Bounty Hunter role in #roles.
Plugin drops can back up your proof.
Plugin drops are not live yet.

images.caption: A contract poster. Press Submit Proof under it to open your proof thread.

short: Contracts hang in #bounty-board. Two at a time, one PvM, one Skilling.
The drop has to be earned after the contract posts. Screenshot it, press **Submit Proof** on the poster.
Staff make the final call.
pages.title: Bounties

pages.blurb: `/events` lists upcoming server events. The competitions rotate through Boss, Skill, and Raid of the Week.
short: `/events` lists what is coming up in the server.
Competitions run on Wise Old Man: Boss of the Week, Skill of the Week, and Raid of the Week, on rotation.
Winners nominate the next options. Members vote in #voting.
pages.title: Events and competitions

pages.title: Ranks and staff roles

pages.blurb: Fixes for missing numbers, an unsynced log, a bounty drop, empty gains, and clog pages.
fullExtra: **Gains are empty.** Gains build from daily snapshots, so a new name needs a day or two before numbers show.
**A clog page will not come up.** Use the page's in-game name, like `!clog hard clues`. Boss and raid pages show on the KC card instead.
short: **A number is missing.** That page may not be synced yet. The Sync your collection log page has the steps.
**The collection log is not synced.** The Sync your collection log page has the steps.
**A drop did not count for a bounty.** The drop has to land after the contract posts. If yours did, ask staff in your proof thread.
